verdict.rationale: Shortwave's first-party docs describe an AI assistant that can read threads, search your entire email history, and check your calendar, and say the AI connects to Calendar. That covers the core of asking questions across inbox and calendar. However, on the free plan, mail older than 90 days isn't imported or searchable, which limits the "whole inbox" part, and nothing shows how answers are grounded. missing for 10: evidence of grounded or cited answers, concrete examples of who-said-what or outstanding-item queries, independent hands-on corroboration of assistant Q&A quality, full-history coverage on the free plan.
